headline: Legislature approves bill to slow future occupational taxes
snippet: Passed 27-7 after 3 hours debate. Prohibits new municipal occupational taxes without state authorization.

headline: Montgomery's new occupation tax likely to be challenged by the legislature
snippet: Backlash after Montgomery approved 1% occupational tax.

headline: Montgomery occupational tax becomes state issue
snippet: Made retroactive to Feb 1 2020, potentially invalidating Montgomery's tax. Ivey signed March 3.
